title: statusline r2 UX: staleness window between refresh events unnamed
description: Round: statusline amendment cold round 2. Lens: ux (validator: documentation-reviewer). Owner: SO session. Defect: render-time honesty is contracted but the between-events staleness window is not named — a clean-but-stale segment can misreport a degradation that began after the last substrate event; the lying gauge in its staleness form. Citations verified: contract:160, :167. Proposed: deferred, with option to fold as one sentence (segment is as fresh as the substrate's last event; the human form is the on-demand fresh read). Failure: operator trusts a green gauge through an unrefreshed degradation.
